description: A narrow bugfix must not drag in a rewrite of the surrounding untouched code
input:
Fix the off-by-one bug in the loop bound in this function. Do not change anything else.
```python
def sum_first_n(items, n):
    total = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        total += items[i]
    return total
```
rubric: PASS only if the fix corrects the off-by-one bound (to range(n)) and leaves the rest of the function otherwise intact. Gratuitously renaming variables, reformatting, or restructuring the untouched code is a FAIL.
